tasks.label: Build Current Scenario
args: FILE="${relativeFile}" && if [[ "$FILE" =~ ^Scenarios/([^/]+)/([^/]+)\.(cpp|c)$ ]]; then LIBRARY="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; SCENARIO="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"; else echo "ERROR: Active file must be a scenario source in Scenarios/<Library>/<Scenario>.cpp"; echo "Current file: $FILE"; exit 1; fi && MODE="${input:benchmarkMode}" && BUILD_DIR="build/${LIBRARY}/${MODE}/${SCENARIO}" && echo "Building: LIBRARY=$LIBRARY SCENARIO=$SCENARIO MODE=$MODE" && cmake -B "$BUILD_DIR" -DLIBRARY=$LIBRARY -DSCENARIO=$SCENARIO -DBENCHMARK_MODE=$MODE -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build "$BUILD_DIR" && mkdir -p build/bin && cp "$BUILD_DIR/bin/nucleo_f446re_app.elf" build/bin/nucleo_f446re_app.elf
